thread.document:
I used Claude Code to understand HW12, specially the VAE section, by having it generate a complete interactive website explaining the assignment and the underlying VAE theory.

Step 1: I ran Claude Code in the same environment where I asked it to generate HW12 solutions, so it already had access to the homework text and the earlier code.

Step 2: I prompted it with "Can you make an interactive website on how a VAE works, including the theory behind it, and explain it at a level an average student can understand?" Claude Code produced the full site in one shot.

After that, all I had to do was deploy it on GitHub Pages. The full Claude Code chat history is at: 

The website is live here:
https://wicai24.github.io/vae-guide/vae_interactive_guide.html (I actually found this pretty cool and it helped me understand the concept better, lots of cool visualizations and there is even a quiz)
